description: Set a Decision's lifecycle status — proposed / accepted / superseded / rejected (BL-70). Setting it to `proposed` opens it as a decision point: an undecided fork you can register alternatives under. Every other property is preserved.

acted_at.description: When the approver acted, as a plain date. Stored on the approver edge.

approver.description:
The Contributor whose word moves it — draws `AUTHORED_BY role=approver`
in the same call. Optional on this setter because it has consumers, but
an `accepted` written without one is REPORTED in the reply as carrying
nobody's name: that is exactly the write the intent-authority gate
fails a build on. An id naming no Contributor is REFUSED.

name: set_decision_status
